cataloginventory_options_can_subtract.summary: Keep on so available quantity reflects open orders; turn off only when another system owns stock levels.

cataloginventory_options_can_back_in_sto.summary: When a cancelled order returns quantity above the out-of-stock threshold, the product is set back to In Stock automatically. Only relevant while stock is managed.

cataloginventory_options_show_out_of_sto.summary: Off hides out-of-stock products from listings and search, but they stay reachable by their direct URL.
cataloginventory_options_show_out_of_sto.usage: Changing this reindexes the catalog, so the storefront keeps the old behaviour until the reindex finishes.

cataloginventory_options_stock_threshold.summary: Stock level at or below which the product page shows the "Only X left" urgency message. Set 0 to turn the message off.

cataloginventory_options_display_product.summary: Shows or hides the In Stock / Out of Stock label on the storefront. Hiding it doesn't change whether the product can be bought.

cataloginventory_options_not_available_m.summary: When a shopper requests more than is available, choose between telling them exactly how many are in stock or showing a generic shortage message.

cataloginventory_item_options_manage_sto.summary: Master switch for inventory tracking. When off, products are always sellable regardless of quantity.

cataloginventory_item_options_backorders.summary: Lets orders exceed available stock; one option also notifies the shopper that the item is backordered.

cataloginventory_item_options_max_sale_q.summary: Caps units of one product per order. Applies to products on the default settings; a per-product value overrides it.

cataloginventory_item_options_min_qty.summary: The level at which a product flips to Out of Stock. Set it negative (with backorders) to allow quantity below zero.

cataloginventory_item_options_min_sale_q.summary: Minimum units of one product per order. Can vary by customer group and be overridden per product.

cataloginventory_item_options_notify_sto.summary: Feeds the admin Low Stock report only — it doesn't affect whether the product can be sold.

cataloginventory_item_options_auto_retur.summary: Pre-ticks "Return to Stock" on new credit memos so refunded quantities go back to inventory; staff can still change it per memo.

cataloginventory_item_options_enable_qty.summary: Forces purchases in fixed multiples, using the Qty Increments value below.

cataloginventory_item_options_qty_increm.summary: The multiple products must be ordered in — e.g. 6 means 6, 12, 18. Applies only when Qty Increments is enabled.
